summary: Establish the client’s intended look and preferences before selecting a design. Face shape is advisory; never impose a balancing goal the client did not request.
Compare the requested finish with the daily styling time and upkeep the client accepts. School or work does not establish a dress rule; ask for the actual policy.
Growth direction, density, available length and texture affect the feasible outline. Use barber-confirmed observations; unconfirmed photos cannot establish these facts.
Clarify the impact the client wants and how different the result should feel. Offer styling and silhouette tradeoffs rather than mapping every occasion to one haircut.
